skills.name: People-search opt-out playbook
skills.description: Use this when filing official people-search or data-broker opt-out/removal forms in the browser for one authorized subject.
skills.content:
---
name: People-search opt-out playbook
description: >-
  Use this when filing official people-search or data-broker opt-out/removal
  forms in the browser for one authorized subject.
---
# People-search opt-out playbook

## Scope
- One authorized person per agent. Never mix identities. Never guess extra identifiers. Never collect SSN, account passwords, or 2FA in chat. DOB / street / phone only when that site's official form requires them — enter on the computer, do not hoard a dossier.
- Official published opt-out / privacy / removal forms only. Prefer the opt-out URL over a listing. Use Official broker opt-out URLs (family map is in that skill).
- Never hack, scrape behind logins, pay, buy data, DDoS, bypass captcha, or email the site except through its official form.

## Identity: listing-first, least data
Brokers need to match a public listing. They do **not** need a full identity dump.

**First wake (enough to start):**
1. Legal name (as it appears on listings)
2. Cities / metro that should match
3. One monitored confirmation email
4. Optional: live listing URLs (best input — skip search)

**Form-time only (ask then, not at onboarding):**
- Phone (Whitepages voice-code, That's Them, some DSAR forms)
- Street address (That's Them and similar)
- DOB only if the form blocks without it

**Never in chat / never store unless the subject typed it on the computer themselves:** SSN, government IDs, passwords, payment cards.

If the subject pastes a listing URL, treat that URL as the primary key. Do not fan out a name search for other people with the same name.

## Ledger (required)
One line per site/family, updated every submit:

`site | family | listing_url | email_used | submitted_at | confirm | gone | next | parked_until | note`

- `confirm`: needed | sent | done
- `gone`: unknown | waiting | yes | reappeared
- `next`: wait-email | stage-2 | relist | retry | done
- Collapse to the **parent family** when one form covers many brands (PeopleConnect, BeenVerified, Spokeo-except-That's-Them, Mississippi Tornado Alley siblings still need their own forms).

## Human in the loop: captcha (and phone) only
- Hand the computer for captcha / Turnstile / FunCaptcha, and for phone voice-codes.
- If an authorized inbox teammate exists, they fetch confirmation emails and return the link or one-time code. Do not ask the subject to click email links.
- If no inbox teammate: remind the subject once to click the broker mail, then wait. Do not watch their inbox yourself.
- Login / 2FA / payment still stop.
- Handoff text: solve the captcha AND click submit AND wait for the success page, then hand back.

## What the bot does without a human
- Look up official URLs, match the authorized listing, fill, submit when no captcha.
- After captcha hand-back, screenshot; if green, submit immediately.
- Email fallback: if the first address is rejected (common for uncommon TLDs), use the next authorized email. Ledger which address each site accepted.
- After submit, request the verify link/code (teammate or subject); complete stage-2 unless that page is also captcha.
- One site at a time in the browser. Park after two failed captcha handoffs per site per day, or on explicit rate-limit / TLS-block copy. Ledger everything.

## How to file
1. Check family map — skip child brands already covered by a parent submit still in-flight.
2. Official opt-out URL from the directory.
3. Listing URL if you have one; else name + authorized city search, match only the authorized person.
4. Authorized identifiers only. Switch email on validator rejection.
5. No captcha → submit. Captcha → hand computer.
6. Screenshot on return; green → submit now.
7. Request confirmation mail; complete the link.
8. Update ledger.

## Known site patterns
- Spokeo: listing URL + recaptcha + email confirm. Rate-limits automated privacy requests — park until next day.
- Whitepages: listing URL then phone voice-code.
- TruePeopleSearch / FastPeopleSearch / USPhoneBook / CyberBackgroundChecks: email-link stage-2. Some reject uncommon email TLDs.
- BeenVerified family: search then email verify. FunCaptcha. One parent form covers the family.
- Radaris: human captcha AND submit in one pass. Keep the tracking id.
- That's Them: street often required. Separate from Spokeo despite the registry cluster.
- MyLife: privacyrequest; email code then recaptcha.
- PeopleConnect: email verify then pick record (Intelius / TruthFinder / InstantCheckmate / USSearch / ZabaSearch). Classmates is not covered.
- Nuwber: listing URL + email confirm.
- FamilyTreeNow: optout then emailed stage-2.
- ClustrMaps: may block datacenter IPs — retry from residential or park.
- FastPeopleSearch / USPhoneBook: daily removal caps and recaptcha token expiry — park, do not hammer.
- Infomatics / WeInform / PeopleSearcher / Checksecrets: optOutLight Turnstile. Park after it never clears.

## Mugshots
- Court/jail usually stay. Aggregators: official form only. Stop if they demand payment.

## Quiet rules
- Small batches. Monday: relist check + pending. Site + status, not a privacy essay.

skills.name: Official broker opt-out URLs
skills.description: Use this when you need official people-search opt-out URLs or to map a listing to its parent family. File once per family. Do not spray CCPA privacy-policy URLs.

---
name: Official broker opt-out URLs
description: >-
  Use this when you need official people-search opt-out URLs or to map a listing
  to its parent family. File once per family. Do not spray CCPA privacy-policy
  URLs.
---
# Official broker opt-out URLs

CA registry CSV (for lookups, not a spray list): https://cppa.ca.gov/data_broker_registry/registry2025.csv
DROP (California residents only, not a substitute for other states): https://privacy.ca.gov/drop/

Most registry rows are broker-filed CCPA privacy/DSAR URLs, not dedicated `/optout` forms. Start with the priority overlay below. File **once per family**. Do not spray a 500-row catalog.

Optional local files if present: `/workspace/broker-optout-catalog.md`, `/workspace/broker-families.md`. This skill is the source of truth when those files are missing.

## Family map (file the parent, skip the children)

Child domains inherit a parent only when the CA filing listed them together, first-party terms named them, or a live `/opt-out` redirected. Do not assume coverage unless first-party text says so.

**PeopleConnect** — https://suppression.peopleconnect.us/ (email verify)
Covers: Intelius, TruthFinder, Instant Checkmate, USSearch, ZabaSearch.
Does **not** cover Classmates.
Domains: instantcheckmate.com, intelius.com, peopleconnect.us, truthfinder.com, ussearch.com, zabasearch.com

**BeenVerified** — https://www.beenverified.com/app/optout/search
Covers affiliates: peoplelooker, numberguru, ownerly, neighborwho, peoplesmart, bumper, freephonetracer, emailfinder, moneybot5000, reversephone, wingmate.
Use this parent form. Do not fight NeighborWho/Ownerly Cloudflare on their own `/svc/optout` pages from a datacenter.
Domains: beenverified.com, bumper.com, emailfinder.com, freephonetracer.com, moneybot5000.com, neighborwho.com, numberguru.com, ownerly.com, peoplelooker.com, peoplesmart.com, reversephone.com, wingmate.com

**Spokeo** — https://www.spokeo.com/optout
Covers: spokeo.com, freepeopledirectory.com, peoplewin.com (peoplewin `/optout` redirects here).
Does **not** cover That's Them. That's Them is https://thatsthem.com/optout.
Domains: freepeopledirectory.com, peoplewin.com, spokeo.com, thatsthem.com (That's Them separate)

**Mississippi Tornado Alley / FastPeopleSearch cluster** — sibling sites, **separate forms**. One submit does not cover the cluster.
- FastPeopleSearch: https://www.fastpeoplesearch.com/optout (daily removal cap; park until next day)
- USPhoneBook: https://www.usphonebook.com/removal (rejects uncommon email TLDs; recaptcha token dies fast)
- CyberBackgroundChecks: https://www.cyberbackgroundchecks.com/removal (same TLD issue)
- SmartBackgroundChecks: https://www.smartbackgroundchecks.com/optout
- FastBackgroundCheck: https://www.fastbackgroundcheck.com/optout (same daily cap as FastPeopleSearch)
- USAPeopleSearch / AdvancedBackgroundChecks / SearchPeopleFree `/optout` were dead or 404 when last checked
- peoplesearchnow.com/optout is a name search for the surname "Optout", not a removal form. Do not use it.

**TruePeopleSearch** (Free Data Services) — https://www.truepeoplesearch.com/removal
Separate from FamilyTreeNow.

**FamilyTreeNow** — https://www.familytreenow.com/optout

**MyLife** (InsightBridge) — https://www.mylife.com/privacyrequest
Older `/ccpa-optout` is 410. Avoid the `/privacy` marketing funnel.

**Whitepages** — https://www.whitepages.com/suppression-requests (phone voice-code)

**Nuwber** — https://nuwber.com/removal/link

**Radaris** — https://radaris.com/control-privacy
Do not use `/control/privacy` (Privacy Monitor marketing scan). Keep the tracking id.

**ClustrMaps** — https://clustrmaps.com/bl/opt-out (may block datacenter IPs)

**PeopleFinders** — https://www.peoplefinders.com/opt-out

**CheckPeople** — https://checkpeople.com/opt-out (email verify; site has said 5-7 days after complete)

**Infomatics / optOutLight Cloudflare cluster** — park when Turnstile never clears; retry next day. Do not loop.
- Infomatics: privatereports.com, mugshotlook.com, publicsearcher.com (landing https://www.privatereports.com/optOut/name/landing)
- We Inform: weinform.org, truthrecord.org (`/api/helper/optOutLight/search`)
- The People Searchers: peoplesearcher.com, secretinfo.org
- Truth Now: checksecrets.com, peoplesearchusa.org, inmatesearcher.com, sealedrecords.net (dedicated `/opt_out` has redirected to a paid search landing)

## Priority overlay (file these)

Spokeo, That's Them, Whitepages, BeenVerified parent, TruePeopleSearch, FastPeopleSearch, USPhoneBook, CyberBackgroundChecks, SmartBackgroundChecks, FastBackgroundCheck, Radaris, MyLife, PeopleConnect, Nuwber, FamilyTreeNow, PeopleFinders, ClustrMaps, CheckPeople.

Stay on this overlay unless the subject names a site.

## Out of default overlay

Equifax, TransUnion, Experian, LexisNexis, Acxiom, and other credit/risk brokers: only if the subject names them. Use that company's first-party privacy/rights page. Not people-search listing removal.

## Rules

- One authorized subject. Match listings. Never pay. Never email except through the official form.
- Confirmation links: inbox teammate if one exists, otherwise the subject clicks their own mail.
- If a URL 404s, search `[site] official opt-out` or the CA registry rights URL for that domain.
- California DROP is extra for CA residents, not a replacement for these forms.

skills.name: Relist check
skills.description: Use this on a Monday pass or when a people-search listing may have come back after an opt-out. Check ledger sites only and refile official forms if they reappeared.
skills.content:
---
name: Relist check
description: >-
  Use this on a Monday pass or when a people-search listing may have come back
  after an opt-out. Check ledger sites only and refile official forms if they
  reappeared.
---
# Relist check

## When
Monday pass, or when the person says a listing came back. Small batch. Stay quiet if nothing pending and a quick public search shows no fresh listing.

## How
1. Read the ledger (`site | family | listing_url | email_used | submitted_at | confirm | gone | next | parked_until | note`).
2. Skip rows still `parked_until` in the future, and skip child brands whose parent family submit is still in-flight.
3. For each submitted site that is due (confirmation window passed, or last check older than a week): open the listing URL if you have one, or the site's public name search with authorized city.
4. Match only the authorized person. Do not open or opt out anyone else.
5. If gone: mark `gone=yes`, `next=done`, date.
6. If back: mark `gone=reappeared`, file the official opt-out again using the URL directory skill. Same captcha/handoff rules.
7. If the listing URL 404s but search still finds them, treat as reappeared under a new URL and replace `listing_url`.
8. Park rate-limited or TLS-blocked sites until the next day (`parked_until`).

## Do not
- Do not watch their inbox.
- Do not pay for DeleteMe, Incogni, or mugshot takedowns unless they asked.
- Do not scrape behind logins.
- Do not run a full sweep of the internet. Brokers already in the ledger plus any they named.

skills.name: Broker opt-out handoff
skills.description: Use this when a people-search opt-out is blocked on captcha or phone voice-code and the subject must use the computer for that step only.
skills.content:
---
name: Broker opt-out handoff
description: >-
  Use this when a people-search opt-out is blocked on captcha or phone
  voice-code and the subject must use the computer for that step only.
---
# Broker opt-out handoff

## When
An official people-search / data-broker opt-out form is filled and the next step is captcha, Turnstile, FunCaptcha, or a phone voice-code. Not for passwords, 2FA, or payment.

## Captcha card
Hand the computer with one short instruction:

Solve the captcha, click Submit, wait for the success / confirmation page, then hand back.

After hand-back:
1. Screenshot. If the success page is visible, mark submitted and go to confirmation-email.
2. If captcha is green but not submitted, click Submit immediately (tokens expire).
3. If still blocked, one more handoff the same day. After two failures, park the site until tomorrow.

## Phone voice-code
Hand the computer: take the call or enter the code on this screen, then hand back. Do not ask them to paste the code in chat.

## Do not
- Do not ask for passwords in chat.
- Do not tell them to “just retry later” without parking a date.
- Do not start a second site in another tab during a handoff.

skills.name: Opt-out confirmation email
skills.description: Use this after submitting a people-search opt-out that emails a verify link or code — inbox teammate if one exists, otherwise one reminder to the subject.
skills.content:
---
name: Opt-out confirmation email
description: >-
  Use this after submitting a people-search opt-out that emails a verify link or
  code — inbox teammate if one exists, otherwise one reminder to the subject.
---
# Opt-out confirmation email

## When
An official opt-out form was submitted and the broker will email a verify link or one-time code.

## If an inbox teammate exists
Ask that teammate for the broker's verify link or code for the address used on the form. Do not ask the subject to click. When the link arrives, open it and finish stage-2 unless that page is also captcha (then use Broker opt-out handoff).

## If no inbox teammate
Remind the subject once: check that inbox, click the broker's verify link (or read back the code). Do not watch or log into their mail. Do not nag every hour — one reminder, then wait for them.

## Ledger
Set `confirm=sent` when the form claimed an email was sent. Set `confirm=done` only after stage-2 succeeds or the subject says the confirm mail is finished. Keep `email_used` so retries do not bounce the same rejected address.

## Do not
- Do not open a random inbox.
- Do not treat “email sent” as “listing gone.”

routines.name: monday broker pass
routines.description: Monday morning batch of pending, parked-until-passed, and re-listed people-search opt-outs; stay quiet if nothing is due.
routines.content:
Standing Monday people-search opt-out pass for one authorized subject (never anyone else).

If authorized identifiers are not in memory (legal name, cities, one monitored confirmation email, listing URLs if they have them), stay quiet except to ask the subject once for those identifiers. Do not guess extra PII. Do not file anything until identifiers are in memory. Do not ask for DOB, street, or phone until a form blocks without them.

Otherwise work a small batch of official opt-out or removal forms for pending or re-listed brokers from the ledger and the priority dedicated-forms overlay (Spokeo, Whitepages, BeenVerified parent, TruePeopleSearch, FastPeopleSearch, Radaris, That's Them, MyLife, PeopleConnect, and similar, plus any the subject named). Do not spray a CCPA privacy-policy catalog. Map each listing to its parent family and file once. Prefer a listing URL over a name search. Open the official opt-out URL in this computer's browser, fill, submit.

Update the ledger: site, family, listing_url, email_used, status (queued / submitted / confirm needed / confirm received / confirmed gone / reappeared / parked), park_until, tracking_id.

Human work is captcha and phone voice-code only — hand this computer; submit immediately when captcha is green. If an inbox teammate exists, they fetch confirmation links; otherwise remind the subject once. Never ask for a password in chat. Never invent a click path. Park after two captcha fails, a daily cap, or Turnstile that never clears; retry next day. One browser tab.

Never hack, scrape behind logins, buy data, DDoS, bypass access controls, email sites except through their opt-out form, or pay for DeleteMe/Incogni unless the subject asked.

Stay quiet if nothing is pending and a quick search shows no fresh listings. Report site + status when you did work, not a privacy essay.
